home.intro: Wu Wei Kung Fu is an authentic system of Chinese martial arts built on the Taoist philosophy of 'non-action'. Founded by Sifu Ghahremani, it is taught in Iran today by Sifu Ehsan Shayanfar, who brings over 25 years of experience.
home.philosophy: In Chinese thought, Wu Wei means deliberate, measured action and the avoidance of futile struggle. Wu Wei means remaining calm during the hardest tasks so they are performed with the greatest skill and efficiency. Wu Wei means embracing moderation and balance (the law of Yin-Yang). Wu Wei means being as flexible and yielding as water, yet powerful and surging like a torrent.
home.layers: The Three Layers of the Journey
home.layer1d: Chaos, raw power and iron — every student's starting point
home.layer2d: Order, Wing Chun forms and the precise geometry of motion
home.layer3d: Qigong, pure energy and calm at the heart of the storm
home.bookDesc: "Qigong the Authentic Chinese Kung Fu Way (Wu Wei Tao)" by Sifu Ehsan Shayanfar explores the art of electromagnetic energy, corrective movements, acupressure and massage therapy.

about.title: About Us
about.sifuRole: Founder & Head Instructor | Official Wu Wei Tao Representative of Alborz Province
about.sifuBio: Sifu Ehsan Shayanfar, the official representative of Wu Wei Tao in Alborz Province, has over two decades of experience across Karate, Wrestling, Boxing, Wing Chun, Bodybuilding, TRX and CrossFit, making him one of the most well-rounded martial arts masters in Iran. He is the author of "Qigong the Authentic Chinese Kung Fu Way (Wu Wei Tao)" and president of the Wushu Federation of West Tehran Province.
